storyboard-grid-25.name: 25-panel storyboard
storyboard-grid-25.description: A 5×5 sequence of one story, for turning into a video
storyboard-grid-25.prompt: Use [📎 Character or scene] as the reference. Create ONE image: a storyboard grid of exactly 5 rows and 5 columns, 25 equal panels in total, separated by thin white gutters, read left to right and top to bottom as one continuous sequence in time. Story: {✏️ the story}. Every panel keeps the same people, outfits, location and lighting as the reference. Vary shot size and camera angle from panel to panel like a film storyboard. No text, no numbers.

costume-sheet.prompt: Use [📎 Character] as the character reference. Create ONE image: a character costume sheet on a plain light grey background. The left two thirds: exactly 3 full-body figures of equal width side by side, left to right the front, side and back views of the same character, at the same scale; the right third: a 2 by 2 grid of exactly 4 equal close-up panels of {✏️ the hands or another body part}. The same photorealistic photographic style as the reference, not an illustration. The face, hairstyle, outfit, colours and body proportions match the reference in every view. Even studio lighting. No text.

character-bible.name: Character sheet
character-bible.description: Views, expressions, poses and details of one character
character-bible.prompt: Use [📎 Character] as the only character reference; do not invent a new character. Create ONE image, a 4:3 landscape character reference sheet of exactly this character: pure white background, clean technical layout, thin grey lines between panels, even margins, a clear English label in small sans-serif capitals at the top left of each section named in capital letters below, written exactly as that name; the top text block and the bands themselves get no label. The sheet has three horizontal bands, top to bottom. Top band, about 12% of the height: on the left, a text block with NAME, ROLE, AGE, PERSONALITY (3 to 5 keywords) and THEME (one sentence): {✏️ name, role, age, 3 to 5 personality keywords and a one-line theme}; on the right, COLOR PALETTE, one row of exactly 8 equal square swatches of flat colour taken from the hair, skin and outfit, with no text or pattern in them. Middle band, about 48% of the height, the largest area: on the left 70%, MAIN VIEWS, exactly 4 full-body figures of equal width in one row, left to right FRONT, 3/4, SIDE, BACK, standing in a neutral pose with nothing held in the hands and wearing everything the reference shows on the body, including anything on the back or over a shoulder, all at the same scale, with a vertical height ruler with tick marks at the left edge; on the right 30%, two panels stacked top to bottom: SILHOUETTE, a solid black front silhouette and side silhouette side by side, then CLOSE-UP, one panel, chest up, showing a strong emotion. Bottom band, about 40% of the height, three rows of equal height; within each row every panel is the same size and the panels fill the row's width. Row 1, EXPRESSIONS, exactly 8 head-and-shoulders panels: calm, curious, nervous, surprised, scared, sad, determined, relaxed. Row 2, exactly 9 panels: first MICRO-EXPRESSIONS, 5 head-and-shoulders panels: tense eyes, slight smile, clenched mouth, faint fear, controlled breathing (lips slightly parted while slowly exhaling); then HEAD ANGLES, 4 head-and-shoulders panels: three-quarter, profile, looking up, looking down. Row 3, exactly 12 panels: first POSES, 3 full-body panels: relaxed, tense, confident; then COSTUME DETAILS, 4 panels: hairstyle, fabric, accessory, shoes; then HANDS, 5 panels: relaxed, tense, pointing, gripping, touching the face. Every panel shows this same character with the same face, hairstyle, outfit, colours and body proportions as the reference. Style: {✏️ the same style as the reference}. Even studio lighting. No text except the labels and the top text block.

character-showcase-orbit.name: Character orbit
character-showcase-orbit.description: The camera circles the character to show the look
character-showcase-orbit.prompt: [📎 Character] stands still in the middle of {✏️ a place with something close to the camera and something far behind, e.g. a rooftop with railings in front and city towers far away}, relaxed, arms at the sides. The camera starts in front of the character at chest height and circles 180 degrees around the character's right side to end behind them, smoothly and at an even speed, keeping the same distance, height and focal length and always facing the character, then holds still. The character does not turn with the camera and does not step away; only the camera moves. The near things sweep past quickly and the far background moves slowly as the camera circles. Soft light from one side. No text on screen.

pet-selfie-vlog.prompt: A vertical phone selfie vlog. travel-city-walk.name: City walk travel vlog
travel-city-walk.description: One traveler walks through a city, scene by scene
travel-city-walk.prompt: A vertical travel vlog of [📎 Traveler] walking through {✏️ a city, e.g. Lisbon}: the same face, hairstyle and outfit as in the picture in every scene. 0–4 s: {✏️ scene 1, e.g. climbing a steep tiled street}. 4–8 s: {✏️ scene 2}. 8–12 s: {✏️ scene 3}. 12–16 s: {✏️ scene 4}. 16–20 s: {✏️ scene 5}. 20–24 s: they stop at a viewpoint at golden hour and look out over the city. In each scene one camera move: following behind, then beside, then in front. Natural light, the sun getting lower scene by scene. Sound: the street sounds of each place, footsteps, light music at the end. No text on screen.

twist-comedy-skit.name: Twist comedy skit

twist-comedy-skit.prompt: A comedy skit with [📎 Character], the same face, hairstyle and outfit as in the picture, shot completely straight like a serious drama. The punchline: {✏️ the twist we see at the end, e.g. the burglar was the dog all along}. 0–2 s hook: {✏️ something odd already happening}. 2–5 s setup: {✏️ what the character thinks is going on}. 5–7 s countdown: the tension builds, the camera slowly pushes in. 7–10 s twist: the punchline is revealed on screen. 10–13 s reaction: the character's frozen, deadpan face. 13–15 s button: {✏️ one last small gag}. Steady camera, serious lighting. Sound: dramatic music that stops dead at the twist, then silence. No text on screen.
